name: Mem0
tier_reason: Most-adopted agent-memory library; seed hypothesis target (agent-memory LLM extraction cost); pattern source for CAP-57
members: Mem0 Platform (managed, proprietary optimisations, native graph memory)
release_cadence: Roughly weekly to biweekly; algorithm break 2026-04-14 (Python 2.0.0 / TypeScript 3.0.0)
license: Apache-2.0 (OSS library and server); Platform proprietary managed service
redistribution_notes: Apache-2.0 library is redistributable; features and benchmark optimisations gated to the managed Platform; LICENSE appendix copyright line is unfilled template text.
legal_review_reason: OSS-vs-Platform feature split (typed graph memory removed from OSS in 2026-04) and unconfirmed copyright holder; telemetry (PostHog) on by default
community_vs_enterprise: OSS: library plus self-hosted server (advanced features 'teasers'); Platform: graph memory, all advanced features, vendor benchmark scores
resolution_note: Current OSS is ADD-only single-call extraction; the LLM-driven ADD/UPDATE/DELETE/NOOP pipeline and external graph stores (Neo4j, Memgraph, Kuzu, AGE, Neptune) described in older posts and the 2025 paper were removed in 2026-04. LoCoMo claims are contested between Mem0, Zep and Letta.
decision_summary: BUILD governed EOIP memory store with ACL/tenant/evidence; REUSE patterns (id-aliased single-call extraction, entity-link retrieval signal, explain scores); DEFER Mem0 as runtime dependency

sources.title: Mem0 OSS v2 to v3 migration

name: Letta (MemGPT)
tier_reason: Stateful-agent runtime with explicit memory tiers, sleep-time consolidation and git-versioned memory; reference for CAP-57
members: Letta Code CLI/harness (letta-ai/letta-code, npm @letta-ai/letta-code, PyPI letta >=0.17)
Archived Letta V1 API server (letta-ai/letta archive branch; PyPI letta <=0.16.8)
latest_version: Letta Code 0.34.24 (npm); PyPI letta 0.34.12; last V1 server 0.16.8
release_cadence: Several releases per week for Letta Code; V1 server line archived after 0.16.8
license: Apache-2.0 (letta, letta-code, npm package); Letta Cloud commercial
redistribution_notes: Code redistributable under Apache-2.0; Letta Cloud is a separate commercial service with plan limits; trademark terms not verified.
community_vs_enterprise: OSS harness and App Server; Cloud adds hosted memory repos, backup, cross-device sync, plan size limits (Free 5 MiB, Pro 50 MiB per repo)
resolution_note: Name trap: PyPI 'letta' switched from Python server (<=0.16.8) to the Letta Code CLI; letta-ai/letta main now points to letta-code and the V1 server is retired on the archive branch. Docs conflict on Docker (deprecated vs self-hosting path). Current App Server source not read; reconstruction uses V1 wheel 0.16.8.
action_reason: Named entry, verified; scope clarified across server, Letta Code and archived V1
decision_summary: BUILD prompt-budgeted core tier, proposal-only consolidation worker and governed memory facts; REUSE git-versioned memory pattern (EXPERIMENT); REJECT Letta runtime as dependency

name: Neo4j GraphRAG package
tier_reason: First-party GraphRAG and KG-builder library of a required EOIP backend; reuse/integration candidate
members: Retrievers: Vector, VectorCypher, Hybrid, HybridCypher, Text2Cypher, Tools, Pinecone/Qdrant/Weaviate
license: Apache-2.0 with parts under Python Software Foundation License 2.0
redistribution_notes: Library is redistributable; it is useful only against Neo4j, whose Community Edition is GPLv3 (bundling has GPL duties; customer-supplied network access is lower risk). PSF-licensed portions need attribution.
legal_review_reason: Dependency on Neo4j server licensing (CE GPLv3, Enterprise commercial) when packaged in a white-label appliance; mixed Apache/PSF notices
community_vs_enterprise: Library is open source; Enterprise customers get support; server features (multi-database, RBAC) Enterprise-only per C01-neo4j
resolution_note: Supersedes deprecated neo4j-genai; distinct from Neo4j LLM Graph Builder app (C05) and LlamaIndex/LangChain Neo4j integrations. Components left the 'experimental' namespace in 1.19.0 but the KG builder is still documented as experimental.
action_reason: Registry ADD from master prompt; verified and current
decision_summary: INTEGRATE as optional Neo4j-specific retriever module; REUSE VectorCypher and EXPLAIN read-only guard patterns; EXPERIMENT with extractor and pruner feeding the governed pipeline; REJECT as mandatory dependency (Neo4j-only, no ACL, direct writes)
